thesis.description: Will GreenCart complete its purchase of FreshWay Foods by the end of 2026, and at what final price?
thesis.outcome: Whether the FreshWay purchase completes by 31 December 2026.
thesis.period: By 31 December 2026, the date GreenCart gives for completion.

article.title: GreenCart to buy FreshWay Foods for about $900 million
article.text: GreenCart Grocers (GRCR) agreed to buy the regional chain FreshWay Foods for about $900 million in cash, subject to a shareholder vote in September and to closing conditions. The company said it expects to complete the purchase by 31 December 2026. The final price may be adjusted for FreshWay's working capital at closing.

fiscal_year_note: GRCR's fiscal year ends in January and is named for the calendar year in which it ends: FY2027 runs from February 2026 to January 2027. On 2026-07-10 this year is FY2027 and next year is FY2028.

article.title: GreenCart lifts full-year revenue outlook
article.text: GreenCart Grocers (GRCR) raised its full-year outlook on Thursday, saying it now expects revenue of about $17.2 billion for fiscal 2027, the year ending 30 January 2027, up from the $16.8 billion it guided in March. New stores in the south-west opened ahead of plan. The full-year result is published with the fourth-quarter earnings release in mid-March 2027. Shares rose 3%.

fiscal_year_note: GRCR's fiscal year ends in January and is named for the calendar year in which it ends: FY2027 runs from February 2026 to January 2027. On 2026-07-10 this year is FY2027 and next year is FY2028.

other_fields.favourable_why: Higher revenue is good for the grocer's business.

article.title: GreenCart sets revenue targets at investor day
article.text: GreenCart Grocers (GRCR) set out targets at its investor day on Thursday: revenue of about $18.5 billion in fiscal 2028, the year ending January 2028, and about $20 billion in fiscal 2029, the year ending January 2029. Its current fiscal year, 2027, ends on 30 January 2027. Chief executive Mara Olsen said new stores would carry most of the growth.

article.title: Regulator opens in-depth review of GreenCart-FreshWay deal
article.text: The competition regulator opened an in-depth review of GreenCart Grocers' (GRCR) purchase of FreshWay Foods and set a deadline of 31 March 2027 for its decision. Analysts widely expect the deal to be cleared on condition that GreenCart sells stores in overlapping towns. GreenCart said it would cooperate fully.

article.text: FreshWay Foods, a regional grocery chain and a competitor of GreenCart Grocers (GRCR), said it expects 2026 revenue of about $2.4 billion after opening twelve stores.
